title: The impact of state and dispositional mindfulness on prospective memory: A virtual reality study
authors: Girardeau, J., Blondé, P., Makowski, D., Abram, M., Piolino, P., & Sperduti, M.
summary: Prospective memory is remembering to do something later, and it is what mind wandering is most likely to cost. This virtual-reality study separates state from dispositional mindfulness and asks which of the two predicts remembering an intention in a realistic environment.
